is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) mosquitoes (specifically Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s.) collected from Agboville, Cote d'Ivoire (Page 3, Section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped target site mutations including Vgsc L995F, Vgsc L995S, Vgsc V402L, Vgsc N1570Y, Ace-1 G280S (Ace1-280S), as well as Ace-1 duplication (Ace1_AgDup) (Page 3, Sections 2.4 and 2.5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 5, Table 2 and Table 3 provide exact sample sizes and genotype counts for Vgsc-995F, Vgsc-402L, and Ace1-280S broken down by species, locality, and bioassay phenotype (alive vs dead).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae and pupae of Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) were collected from natural breeding sites in four rural villages in the department of Agboville, southern Cote d'Ivoire between September and October 2019 (Page 3, Section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original primary research article reporting field mosquito collections, WHO tube bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from four specific villages in Agboville department, southern Cote d'Ivoire: Boa Vincent (5 53'41.1"N, 4 35'32.136"E), Ango (5 51'50.364"N, 4 22'54.624"E), Gbalekro (5 56'57.408"N, 4 16'41.34"E), and Ouanguie (5 51'59.112"N, 4 13'42.888"E) (Page 3, Section 2.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from September to October 2019 (Page 3, Section 2.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports original mosquito field collections carried out in late 2019 by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, sample sizes, species breakdown, and bioassay phenotypic data are fully reported in the main text tables (Table 1, Table 2, Table 3).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site / CNV resistance markers in Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) field-collected as larvae/pupae in late 2019 across four villages in Agboville department, southern Côte d'Ivoire. Genotyping revealed high frequencies of Vgsc-995F, Vgsc-402L, Ace1-280S, and Ace1_AgDup, with genotypes provided separately by bioassay survival status.
